title: Select the checked engine through the public header
problem: The separately qualified engine must replace both old output paths while preserving API spellings.
design: The public wrapper selects the same engine tested throughout this stack. Existing macros, static formatters and built-in SYCL formatters remain available.
tradeoffs: Void compatibility calls discard checked status. Host checks do not replace preserved accelerator campaign evidence.
source_changes: Restore all aeff historical suite migrations: oracle output is no longer truncated to staging capacity; null strings are checked for rejection; both compatibility routes test shortest floats and fast-math subnormals. These are restored qualified test behaviors, not new formatter algorithms.
